title: Release quest-cli 0.7.0 (paired with lore 0.7.0)
description:
Bump quest-cli from 0.6.2 to 0.7.0, paired in lockstep with lore-cli 0.7.0 (both parked at 0.6.2 as of the pre-tag audit, OPAG-142). Landing the version bump on dev/main is ordinary delivery; the tag and the publish are separate, later, user-authorized steps -- this task covers the bump only.

Verified before starting: npm holds no 0.7.0 for any of the seven @opum-ai/quest* package names (checked live). Bun 1.3.14 matches package.jsons pinned packageManager.

File list, per docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md#what-a-version-bump-touches (written 2026-09-14 from a dedicated pre-tag audit) plus one gap that audit missed and this task found: .claude-plugin/plugin.json (0.6.0, unchanged since the 2026-09-10 recreation, stuck two releases behind the CLI it ships alongside -- QCLI-258 the 0.6.0 release task already listed it as a hand-edited site, and nothing enforces it, so it silently drifted through 0.6.1 and 0.6.2).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Version bumped across every hand-edited location (package.json, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture, .claude-plugin/plugin.json) and all six platform packages rebuilt via a CI dispatch of prepublication-qualification.yml against the release branch (not a local build-platform-packages.mjs run), with check:packages/test:packages both green, landed as dev-only prep -- no tag, no promotion beyond dev->main, no publish yet
bun.lock regenerated so its platform-package optionalDependencies pins match the new version (QCLI-292s subject, touched here regardless of that tasks own resolution)
CLAUDE.md managed Quest block regenerated against the freshly built local binary, not the globally installed CLI
CHANGELOG.md Unreleased heading moved to the new version with todays date, not before this bump actually lands
dev promoted to main via the standard fast-forward sequence once the bump PR is green

plan: 2. Bump the four independent hand-edited sources plus .claude-plugin/plugin.json to 0.7.0, and hand-sync root optionalDependencies + each platform package.json .version field (text only, binaries untouched) so check:packages passes; commit
3. Push and dispatch prepublication-qualification.yml against the branch to build real platform binaries in CI (no local build-platform-packages.mjs run)
4. Download the six quest-package-<target> artifacts, replace npm/quest-<platform>/{package.json,bin/quest(.exe),LICENSE}, update root package.json questPlatformPackages checksums

5. Regenerate bun.lock via bun install; regenerate CLAUDE.md managed block against the freshly built local darwin-arm64 binary (execute before final delete-and-recreate per the SIGKILL hazard runbook section)
6. Move CHANGELOG.md Unreleased heading to 0.7.0 with todays date
7. bun run check && check:packages && test:packages all green; commit
8. PR into dev, wait for source-gates + Tracker integrity green, squash-merge
9. Promote dev to main via the standard fast-forward sequence
10. Report; do not tag or dispatch release.yml
implementationNotes:
HANDOFF at context-budget recycle, 2026-09-15. Branch chore/QCLI-294-release-0.7.0, clean and pushed at 7a5d3de. No tag, no release.yml, nothing published.

CORRECTION TO THE RECYCLE BRIEF FIRST, because acting on it as written wastes a cycle: the qualification run cited in the recycle instruction (34946220664) FAILED and is dead. The LIVE run is 34946440591, dispatched against 13386e6, in_progress at handoff with source-gates running. Watch that one. Also, bun.lock is already DONE (commit 13386e6), not pending in stage two as the brief listed.

STAGE ONE, DONE AND PUSHED (four commits):
- 00d1318 tracker task file, kept separate so the release branch history stays reviewable (QCLI-271s recorded lesson about tracker notes on release branches).
- cd338ac six version-string sites to 0.7.0: package.json .version, its six optionalDependencies pins, src/application/version.ts QUEST_VERSION, src/contract/tracker/index.ts QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json questVersion, .claude-plugin/plugin.json .version, plus each of the six npm/quest-<platform>/package.json .version fields.
- 13386e6 bun.lock regenerated.
- 7a5d3de CHANGELOG heading moved to 0.7.0 dated 2026-09-15, plus two runbook corrections.

THE ORDERING, VERIFIED NOT ASSUMED -- STRINGS FIRST, BYTES SECOND. check-package-artifacts.mjs tests version-string agreement and checksum-to-bytes agreement as INDEPENDENT conditions. So a commit can move every version string while leaving the binaries, every questBinarySha256, and package.jsons questPlatformPackages map untouched and still self-consistent with the old bytes. That state passes check:packages (verified exit 0), which keeps source-gates green, which is the ONLY thing that lets immutable-candidates (needs: source-gates) run and build the real binaries. Bump only the root version and the gate that would let CI fix it is the gate the mismatch breaks. This reconciles a real contradiction between the runbooks Prerequisites bullet and its What-a-version-bump-touches section; both are now corrected in 7a5d3de.

bun.lock belongs in the STRINGS commit, learned the hard way: run 34946220664 failed at source-gates very first step with "lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen", ahead of typecheck, tests and check:packages. What bun install produced is correct and will look alarming if unexpected: the six requirement pins moved to 0.7.0 AND the six resolved entries were dropped entirely, integrity hashes and all, because @opum-ai/quest-*@0.7.0 does not exist on the registry to resolve. They come back on the first bun install AFTER publication -- exactly what commit 101b265 did for 0.6.2. A lockfile with requirement pins and no resolved entries for these six is the correct between-bump-and-publish state.

AUDIT GAP FOUND: .claude-plugin/plugin.json is a sixth hand-edited version site the pre-tag audit missed, and it was already stale -- reading 0.6.0 since the 2026-09-10 recreation, wrong through the abortive 0.6.1 and through the 0.6.2 that shipped. QCLI-258 listed it once; the knowledge was lost. Nothing generates it, no test compares it to package.json. Now in the runbook list.

STAGE TWO, NOT STARTED, IN ORDER:
1. Wait for run 34946440591 to go green (six immutable-candidates matrix jobs plus source-gates). If source-gates fails again, read the log before changing anything -- both failures so far were real and specific.
2. gh run download 34946440591 --name quest-package-<target> for all six targets (darwin-arm64, darwin-x64, linux-arm64, linux-x64, win32-arm64, win32-x64) into a scratch dir. KEEP those downloaded bytes untouched as the source of truth; you need them again at step 6.
3. Replace npm/quest-<target>/{package.json,bin/quest(.exe),LICENSE} from each artifact. chmod +x all six binaries including both .exe.
4. Update package.jsons questPlatformPackages checksum map to the six new digests (each artifacts own package.json carries its questBinarySha256; they must agree).
5. Regenerate CLAUDE.mds managed Quest block: ./npm/quest-darwin-arm64/bin/quest agents --update-instructions --target claude -- the FRESHLY BUILT LOCAL binary, never the globally installed CLI on PATH, which reads its own running version and will silently write 0.6.2 back while reporting state: current. That exact mistake happened at 0.6.1.
6. SIGKILL HAZARD, and step 5 just triggered it. Executing the darwin-arm64 Mach-O taints its vnode, so the next git operation that mmaps it gets SIGKILLed (exit 137) -- and that takes down unscoped git status/add/commit on unrelated paths too. Do all execution you need FIRST (steps 5 and 7), then as the LITERAL LAST action before any git command: rm npm/quest-darwin-arm64/bin/quest and recreate it from the untouched step-2 download (fresh inode), with ZERO execution between that recreate and the commit. Runbook section "A locally-rebuilt darwin-arm64 binary can SIGKILL git on this host" has the escape hatches if it bites anyway.
7. bun run check && bun run check:packages && bun run test:packages, all exit 0. (Execution happens here, so this is before step 6s recreate.)
8. Commit stage two, push, open PR into dev. Wait for source-gates AND Tracker integrity green ON THE EXACT HEAD SHA -- read them by name via gh api repos/opum-ai/quest-cli/commits/<sha>/check-runs, not the PR rollup. Squash-merge.
9. Promote dev to main: open a dev->main PR, confirm those same two required contexts green on that exact SHA, then git push origin origin/dev:main (the explicit remote-tracking ref, never bare dev). promotion-is-manual will report FAILURE and mergeStateStatus will read UNSTABLE -- both are the always-fail tripwire working as designed, not blockers. Never the merge button.
10. STOP. Do NOT create the tag and do NOT dispatch release.yml. The tag and publish happen together at the users keyboard; lore-cli bumps to 0.7.0 in lockstep and the orchestrator sequences the pair once both report. Report the bump with every site named.

Local checkout: branch chore/QCLI-294-release-0.7.0, working tree clean, HEAD equals origin at 7a5d3de.
